## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
Sector Rotation, not Risk-Off. Breadth: 7/11 sectors positive with Financials and Industrials showing strength; Leadership: Broad (4 sectors in Top 5). Major divergence among large-cap techs (NVDA, MSFT, AAPL) — watch for trend break.

2. Which sectors are leading?
Financials lead: COF (1W: +0.09% | 1M: +19.73%) ABOVE TREND, USB (1W: +0.30% | 1M: +17.03%) ABOVE TREND, PNC (1W: -0.56% | 1M: +16.78%) CORRECTION. Consumer Discretionary strong: TSLA (1W: +3.50% | 1M: +14.27%) ABOVE TREND, GM (1W: -0.36% | 1M: +18.79%) CORRECTION. Materials: FCX (1W: -0.60% | 1M: +19.55%) CORRECTION, NEM (1W: +0.03% | 1M: +15.17%) ABOVE TREND.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Utilities weak with short-term bounces: EXC (1W: +2.62% | 1M: -4.66%) RECOVERY, DUK (1W: +2.66% | 1M: -5.15%) RECOVERY. Communication pressured: T (1W: +0.25% | 1M: -4.84%) RECOVERY, TMUS (1W: +2.07% | 1M: -5.97%) RECOVERY. Energy soft: VLO (1W: -5.24% | 1M: -11.59%) BELOW TREND, XOM (1W: -1.78% | 1M: -1.36%) BELOW TREND.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: EL (1W: -0.25% | 1M: +20.03%) CORRECTION, COF (1W: +0.09% | 1M: +19.73%) ABOVE TREND, FCX (1W: -0.60% | 1M: +19.55%) CORRECTION, GM (1W: -0.36% | 1M: +18.79%) CORRECTION, USB (1W: +0.30% | 1M: +17.03%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Broad (4 sectors in Top 5). Style: Value/Cyclical.

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: ORCL (1W: -10.25% | 1M: -19.06%) BELOW TREND, AMD (1W: -10.53% | 1M: -13.97%) BELOW TREND, NVDA (1W: -5.52% | 1M: -5.74%) BELOW TREND, VLO (1W: -5.24% | 1M: -11.59%) BELOW TREND, AMZN (1W: -3.91% | 1M: -0.58%) BELOW TREND. Weakness concentrated in high-multiple tech and select energy names.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Strong 1W movers: TSLA (1W: +3.50% | 1M: +14.27%) ABOVE TREND, LLY (1W: +3.21% | 1M: +1.14%) ABOVE TREND, BA (1W: +2.80% | 1M: +8.81%) ABOVE TREND; downside momentum: AMD (1W: -10.53% | 1M: -13.97%) BELOW TREND, ORCL (1W: -10.25% | 1M: -19.06%) BELOW TREND, CAT (1W: -10.19% | 1M: +2.74%) CORRECTION. Major divergence among mega-caps (AAPL CORRECTION, MSFT BELOW TREND, NVDA BELOW TREND) — tactical, not a confirmed regime shift.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Mixed with CORRECTION/BELOW TREND concentration. Tech: 11/19 positive. NVDA (1W: -5.52% | 1M: -5.74%) BELOW TREND, MSFT (1W: -1.52% | 1M: -3.40%) BELOW TREND, AAPL (1W: -2.23% | 1M: +1.65%) CORRECTION.

8. Financials Outlook?
Financials remain the cyclical leader. Financials: 15/20 positive. COF (1W: +0.09% | 1M: +19.73%) ABOVE TREND, USB (1W: +0.30% | 1M: +17.03%) ABOVE TREND, JPM (1W: -0.76% | 1M: +5.20%) CORRECTION.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Mixed with defensive elements but not dominant. Healthcare: 9/15 positive. JNJ (1W: +0.15% | 1M: +5.83%) ABOVE TREND, LLY (1W: +3.21% | 1M: +1.14%) ABOVE TREND, PFE (1W: -2.95% | 1M: -1.61%) BELOW TREND.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Favor Financials and cyclicals given broad leadership (COF ABOVE TREND, USB ABOVE TREND, TSLA ABOVE TREND); reduce exposure to large-cap techs showing structural weakness (NVDA BELOW TREND, MSFT BELOW TREND, ORCL BELOW TREND). Style: Value/Cyclical over Growth while major-cap tech divergence resolves.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: TSLA (1W: +3.50% | 1M: +14.27%) ABOVE TREND, COF (1W: +0.09% | 1M: +19.73%) ABOVE TREND, BA (1W: +2.80% | 1M: +8.81%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: NVDA (1W: -5.52% | 1M: -5.74%) BELOW TREND, AMD (1W: -10.53% | 1M: -13.97%) BELOW TREND, ORCL (1W: -10.25% | 1M: -19.06%) BELOW TREND.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Financials (15/20 positive) and Consumer Discretionary (9/12 positive). BEARISH: Utilities (1/6 positive) and Energy (3/8 positive); Technology requires monitoring for resolution of divergence (Tech: 11/19 positive).

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
NVDA: reclaim above recent swing highs would shift risk tone for Tech; AAPL: failure to regain 1M trend would deepen CORRECTION; JPM: sustained strength above recent resistance would reinforce Financials leadership; TSLA: hold near current momentum to confirm ABOVE TREND continuation.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

Rotation from Growth to Value/Cyclicals with breadth supportive (Breadth: 7/11 sectors positive). Financials and select cyclicals showing strength (COF ABOVE TREND, USB ABOVE TREND, TSLA ABOVE TREND). Key risk is large-cap tech divergence (NVDA BELOW TREND, MSFT BELOW TREND, AAPL CORRECTION) — watch for trend confirmation.
